term: reason, intentionality/mental causation, personal explanation and theistic best explanation in #116
definition: Reason is said to involve intentionality and mental causation; their explanations are restricted to personal explanations. A further explicit bridge ranks a theistic account as best. These are source explanatory commitments, not identities between mental causation, formal reasons, actual grounding or a divine individual.
note: Can-only restricts admissible explanation, not existence of an actual explanation. Personal-to-theistic ranking, involvement-to-explanation transfer, comparative adequacy and best-explanation-to-truth remain open; no God signature, unique/necessary bearer or causal dictionary is selected.
